name: Defiler Assassin

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Orb Implement
items.description: Using a nonmagical implement confers no benefit. You can purchase a magic implement to gain an enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your arcane powers.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: Wizards keep the spells they’ve learned in a spellbook.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Defiling
traits.details: Whenever a defiler assassin uses an implement power, each enemy within 3 squares of it takes 2 necrotic damage.

traits.name: Implement Assassin
traits.details: A defiler assassin deals 1d6 extra damage with attacks with the implement keyword against any target granting combat advantage to it.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target grants combat advantage until the end of the defiler assassin’s next turn.
fire damage, and the target grants combat advantage and takes ongoing 5 necrotic damage (save ends both).

powers.name: Defiling Scourge
powers.trigger: An enemy within 10 squares of the defiler assassin spends a healing surge.

effect.description: The defiler assassin regains a number of hit points equal to half the value of the triggering healing surge, and ashen scourge recharges.
